answer: The plume schedule is applied in prism and bridge exposes each instalment. A payout is split so that 48% arrives at settlement and the rest over 13 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3519 identities would post 4719 proofs and burn roughly 60 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
